contract_name: SEIS AI Command Core Local Integration
purpose: Connect the local SEIS AI demo, Command Center AI Core view, website demo surface, and restored AI Core contract packages without live provider calls.

surfaces.label: SEIS AI Command Core web demo
surfaces.role: Local deterministic AI command workspace for routing, agents, prompts, knowledge, evals, approvals, audit, and web-to-macOS handoff.

surfaces.label: SEIS demo website
surfaces.role: Contract-first browser surface that links operators into the AI Command Core demo.

surfaces.label: SEIS Command Center
surfaces.role: Ecosystem operating interface with fixture-backed AI Core contract inspection.

surfaces.label: SEIS AI Command Core macOS
surfaces.role: SwiftUI desktop demo that receives local deterministic handoffs from the web demo.

boundaries: No browser provider API key entry or storage.
No live OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Qwen, local model, SSH, deployment, payment, database, or production action.
All AI behavior shown by the web and Command Center surfaces is deterministic local fixture behavior.
External provider routing remains server-side only and approval-gated until separate credentials, redaction, audit, and deployment policy are reviewed.
next_safe_steps: Keep the static web demo and Command Center fixture-backed until a server-side provider adapter exists.
Add route-level links from the broader website only after publish target and path strategy are approved.
Do not claim model training, live provider execution, or production readiness from this local contract.
